assessment.reason: The reviewed replay reports and all diagnostics are finite, generation-linked and internally consistent. Source trade-offs are material and disclosed; retaining the immutable contrast for evaluation does not certify either model or select a better target model.
key_limitations: Bansal BMI rank association and low/high TG-tertile BMI separation worsen.
Oh pooled BMI coefficient and sex-specific TG SD discrepancies worsen.
Joint Tromso adjusted log interaction itself is not an execution-backed replay diagnostic under the supplied operators.
Source contexts approximate unreported age-BMI dependence and omit adjustment covariates; measurement/population transport and shared-reference covariance remain unresolved.
Three fixed seeds reflect residual Monte Carlo variation only. No uncertainty interval, score, p-value or target-performance claim is derived.

read_boundary: Only baseline_portfolio.json, joint_evidence_portfolio.json and the six named short-path source_replays/<id>/replay.json reports; no target executions, custody, reference outcomes or target evaluation results.
